caption: The video captures a close-up of two extended fingertips of a hand, a black ring visible on a curled finger behind them, pressed against a hairy skin surface with dark green fabric in the background. Two flat rubber bands, one tan and one pale pink, are looped around these fingers. The visible action is the slow reconfiguration of the bands. The tan band spans the gap horizontally while the pink band hangs as a twisted loop low between the fingers. The tan band reconfigures into separate encircling loops and the pink band hangs lower against the skin. The pink band then rises into an upright loop that progressively straightens into a taller, sharper pointed arch between the fingertips. Meanwhile the tan band returns to a taut horizontal span across the gap, holding that configuration.
